data.name: Iyas
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'aya' meaning 'to repair' or 'to heal'. This name is associated with the idea of restoration and mending. In Islamic history, Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) is known to have asked Allah for a name for his son Ishmael, who became the father of the Arab nation. Allah answered his prayer with the name 'Iyas' (Ar-Ra'd 14:35)
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes healing, restoration, and mending.
data.numerology_meaning: Those with the life path number 6 are nurturing and caring, often putting others before themselves. They are loving, protective, and have a strong desire to help and heal others.

in_arabic.name: إياس
in_arabic.meaning: إياس هو اسم يعني الإستغناء أو الغنى عن الناس
in_arabic.long_meaning: إياس هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الإستغناء أو الغنى عن الناس، و هو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم. و إياس بن معاوية هو أحد الصحابة و كان معروفا بكرمه و سخائه.

in_urdu.name: ایاس
in_urdu.meaning: ایاس نام کا مطلب ہے استغنی یا لوگوں سے غنی
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایاس ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے استغنی یا لوگوں سے غنی۔ یہ نام انبیاء کے اصحاب میں سے ایک کے نام سے مشہور ہے، یعنی ایاس بن معاویہ جو کرم و سخا کے لئے جانا جاتا تھا.

in_hindi.name: इयास
in_hindi.meaning: इयास नाम का अर्थ है आत्मनिर्भर या लोगों से स्वतंत्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: इयास एक पुरुष नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। इसका अर्थ है आत्मनिर्भर या लोगों से स्वतंत्र। यह नाम पैगंबर के साथियों में से एक के नाम से प्रसिद्ध है, यानी इयास बिन मुअविया जो उदारता और दान के लिए जाने जाते थे।

in_english.name: Iyas
in_english.meaning: Iyas means self-sufficiency or independence from people
in_english.long_meaning: Iyas is a masculine given name of Arabic origin. It signifies self-sufficiency or independence from people. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'A-Y-S' which conveys the idea of being independent or self-sufficient. Iyas bin Muawiya, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad, was a notable figure known for his generosity and benevolence. The name Iyas holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, reflecting the values of self-reliance and charity.
